resume_document.headline: Junior Full-Stack AI Engineer | Python, Flutter, RAG & Agentic Systems
resume_document.summary: Junior Full-Stack AI Engineer with practical experience building multi-tenant Flutter applications, Python-driven AI agents, and RAG pipelines. Skilled in integrating REST APIs, implementing PostgreSQL row-level security, and optimizing backend performance.

bullets.text: Contributed to the development and maintenance of six Flutter applications, building responsive screens and backend-connected features.
Integrated more than 20 REST API endpoints, Firebase authentication, and real-time data flows into commercial Flutter workflows.
Worked on Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend services while structuring client applications using MVVM and BLoC patterns.
Optimized learning management system database queries and indexing, improving reported p95 API latency from 1,100 ms to 420 ms.
Co-developed textbook-grounded RAG capabilities utilizing embedding-based semantic retrieval and FAISS vector indexing.
Developed student-facing Flutter learning interfaces integrated with backend APIs.
Implemented AI-assisted workflows for quiz generation, flashcards, and learning summaries.
Designed and developed multi-tenant and multi-branch mobile-retail ERP/POS workflows covering inventory, sales, customer credit, and repairs.
Implemented Supabase authentication, branch/tenant access boundaries using PostgreSQL row-level security, and protected RPC workflows.
Developed offline SQLite and Drift persistence with queued inventory mutations, synchronization retries, and idempotency safeguards.
Designed three layers for applicant document extraction, regional university research, and programme eligibility assessment.
Coordinated agent-assisted ranking and shortlisting across seven university options with public, private, and Campus France EEF comparison views.
Implemented master career profile models, JSON persistence, JD analysis, fact retrieval, and initial writer and evaluator nodes in LangGraph.
Executed and evaluated a Writer-Evaluator revision loop interfaced with an OpenAI-compatible local Antigravity bridge.
Designed a vendor-neutral Dart navigation engine decoupling route calculation logic from Mapbox rendering, validated with an architectural boundary test.

evaluation_feedback: All generated bullets strictly adhere to their source facts without introducing unsupported claims, exaggerated metrics, or unverified technologies. The candidate's summary and headline accurately reflect their documented experience, and their background demonstrates strong alignment with the Junior Full-Stack AI Engineer requirements, including Python, Flutter, REST APIs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and PostgreSQL.
